faqs.question: What is the Integrated JEE/NEET Program?
faqs.answer: Integrated CBSE academics with structured JEE and NEET preparation.

faqs.question: Who teaches in this program?
faqs.answer: Expert Physics Wallah faculty and experienced school teachers.

faqs.question: Is the full CBSE curriculum covered?
faqs.answer: Yes, complete CBSE syllabus covered alongside competitive preparation.
